paragraphs.text: The Moon is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who . In that series, Earth's Moon is a gargantuan alien egg , rather than a natural satellite. The egg hatches a draconian creature that lays a new egg to replace its own on a roughly hundred-million year cycle.
The Moon was also used a base from which to thwart multiple alien invasions, including those by the Cybermen , Ice Warriors ( Iraxxa, Empress of Mars ), and the Silents ( Renegade Silent ).
